text:
sam: Quick sync — consolidating postmortem follow-ups from last week's external-dep noise (GCP control-plane flakiness, model-registry auth token regressions, Okta SSO spike). Can we list owners + realistic timelines so we can close the items? I'll push a tracker after this thread.

emily: Yep. I skimmed the draft. We should split into short-term mitigations vs long-term resilience. Short-term = 2 weeks max. Long-term = design work + Q2 deliverables. :white_check_mark:

raj: For the model-registry auth issue: root cause was an unattended token rotation script failing to refresh service account keys. Owner: raj. Action: add monitoring + automatic fallback to read-only repo when token refresh fails. ETA: patch + alerting in 5 business days.

  ```
  # tentative alert rule (prometheus)
  - alert: ModelRegistryTokenRefreshFailures
    expr: increase(model_registry_token_refresh_failures[15m]) > 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: high
  ```

dana: I'll own the dependency runbook updates and recurring regression test. Action items: 1) runbook with step-by-step for auth + model-registry (3 business days), 2) monthly smoke that hits critical flows (first run in 10 days), 3) add an incident tag in the console for external-dep to track recurrence.

matt: For cloud provider control-plane flakiness (GCP), short-term: add region routing fallback + lower RTO for critical routes. Long-term: negotiate SLA with provider + automated circuit-breaker for control-plane errors. I can implement the routing policy change; ETA 4 business days. Example policy snippet below (will refine in PR):

  ```json
  {
    "route": "generation",
    "fallback": ["gcp-europe-west1", "aws-us-east-1"],
    "priority": "latency",
    "circuit_breaker": {
      "threshold": 0.05,
      "window": "1m"
    }
  }
  ```

ops-bot: Created tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/external-dep-regression-watchlist (tracker id: EDRW-112). Next step: owners add checklist items to the tracker and set status.

emily: Owners, please add these exact checklist lines to EDRW-112 and set ETA/timebox: short-term items = "sprint" (<=2w), long-term = quarter. I'll run weekly status digests. Sample checklist lines:

  - [ ] raj — model-registry token fallback + alerting — ETA 5d
  - [ ] matt — routing fallback + circuit-breaker config — ETA 4d
  - [ ] dana — runbook + monthly smoke test — ETA 3d + first smoke in 10d
  - [ ] infra — KMS rotation audit for cloud provider creds — ETA 7d (assign infra)

raj: Claiming model-registry item. I'm starting a branch now, will post PR link when ready. :eyes:

matt: I'll open the routing PR by EOD tomorrow. Will include rollout plan (canary 10% -> 50%).

dana: Added the runbook skeleton to the tracker, included local recovery steps and links to playbooks.

sam: Thanks all. Two operational asks: 1) record one mitigating action that could have prevented recurrence (we should add to runbook as 'preventative control') and 2) tag any related alerts so the regression detector can surface patterns. I'll summarise these thread items in the postmortem follow-up doc and ping product/eng leads. We want to avoid the same pattern (auth token + external control-plane) showing up next quarter.

emily: Agree. Also recommend a monthly external-dep regression report (automated) — should surface frequency, MTTR, and affected routes. I'll prototype using the console query APIs.

sam: OK closing thread for now — everyone update EDRW-112 and we'll review in the weekly ops sync. :thumbsup:
